pkgmetadata.longdescription: Waydroid is a container-based approach to boot a full Android system on a regular GNU/Linux system. It uses Linux namespaces (user, pid, uts, net, mount, ipc) to run Android in a container using a real Android image. Ported to WhaleOS (ChromeOS derivative) to run Android apps natively alongside the ChromeOS UI via the Exo Wayland compositor.

use.flag: Enable AppArmor profile for the LXC container
